categoryError.description: Badge on a suggestion that is a hard grammar or spelling mistake.

categoryStyle.description: Badge on a suggestion about style rather than correctness.

categoryRephrase.description: Badge on a suggestion that rewrites a phrase.

actionApply.description: Button: replace the highlighted text with the suggestion.

actionDismiss.description: Button: hide this one suggestion for now.

actionNever.description: Button: never make this exact suggestion again.

actionDictionary.description: Button: add the highlighted word to the personal dictionary.
